title: Terms Clause — The Fee an Amendment of Coverage is Struck On, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Fee an Amendment of Coverage is Struck On

Clause of the terms of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions fixing the fee an amendment of a subscription's metered coverage is struck on. A full first year is 12 months.

## Clause

Where the subscription stands in its renewal window, the fee the amendment is struck on is the tier's annual subscription fee escalated once at the tier's escalation rate, because the amended coverage carries into the term being renewed. Where the subscription stands in onboarding, the fee the amendment is struck on is the tier's annual subscription fee taken in proportion to the whole months remaining before the term end, of a full first year. In every other case the fee the amendment is struck on is the tier's annual subscription fee.

## By standing

| Status on the subscription record | Fee the amendment is struck on |
|---|---|
| pending renewal | the tier's annual subscription fee escalated once at the tier's escalation rate |
| onboarding | the tier's annual subscription fee multiplied by the whole months remaining before the term end date, divided by 12 |
| any other status | the tier's annual subscription fee, unaltered |

The escalation is applied once, not once for each year of the term. The months remaining are whole months from the day of the amendment to the term end date standing on the subscription record.

## Cases (hypothetical)

*Renewal window, annual fee USD 16800, escalation 3.5 percent.* The fee struck on is 16800 raised by 3.5 percent, that is USD 17388.00.

*Onboarding, annual fee USD 3600, 9 whole months remaining before the term end.* The fee struck on is 3600 multiplied by 9, divided by 12, that is USD 2700.00.

*Active, annual fee USD 3600.* The fee struck on is USD 3600.00.
